_comment: Where scripts/deploy/deploy.mjs can deploy (build queue D1). driver compose = the Docker staging stack in deploy/staging; driver ecs = an AWS environment built by deploy/terraform (project and env as in its terraform.tfvars). baseUrl is what the smoke test calls. smoke.appKey and smoke.assetId (a publishable key and a channel or VOD id that should always play) make the smoke test ask the play gate for a real asset and fetch its manifest; without them it checks the gate refuses a made-up key and skips the manifest. Keys starting with _ are ignored: copy _aws-example to a real name to use it.

smoke.assetId: <a channel or VOD id that always plays>
